Build a sparse spatial neighborhood graph for bilateral HRF and noise pooling

Source: R/spatial_graph.R
build_spatial_graph.Rd

Constructs a compressed-sparse-row (CSR) spatial neighborhood graph ("medusa_spatial_graph") for estimate_crossrun_hrf when pooling = "graph".

Usage

build_spatial_graph(
  x,
  spatial_fwhm = NULL,
  max_neighbors = 32L,
  max_radius = NULL,
  spatial_groups = NULL,
  parcel_boundary = c("soft", "hard", "ignore"),
  metric = c("auto", "geodesic", "euclidean"),
  n_voxels = NULL,
  voxel_ids = NULL,
  x_type = c("auto", "coords", "distance")
)

Arguments

x

Spatial input: a "medusa_nifti_ts" object, a list containing voxel_map (and optional geometry), a voxel_map data.frame with lattice columns i, j, k (or world coordinates x, y, z), a numeric \(V \times D\) coordinate matrix, an edge data.frame with columns from, to (and optional positive dist together with n_voxels), a dist object, a square numeric or sparse/dense Matrix distance matrix (positive finite off-diagonal entries giving neighbor distances; 0 or Inf denoting disconnected pairs), or an existing "medusa_spatial_graph".

spatial_fwhm

Optional positive numeric Gaussian spatial kernel FWHM (in mm or coordinate units). Defaults to 2.5 * median(spacing) for lattice inputs and 2.5 times the median nearest-neighbor distance for coordinate and distance matrices.

max_neighbors

Maximum number of non-self spatial neighbors retained per node (default 32L). Every node always retains itself at index 1 of its CSR row with distance 0.

max_radius

Optional positive search radius cutoff. Defaults to max(2.75 * sigma, 1.80 * step_scale) where sigma = spatial_fwhm / sqrt(8 * log(2)).

spatial_groups

Optional character or integer vector of parcel/group labels of length \(V\). Only restricts graph construction when parcel_boundary = "hard"; under "soft" or "ignore", cross-border neighbors remain in the graph so bilateral pooling can modulate cross-border weights cleanly.

parcel_boundary

Boundary handling when spatial_groups is present: "soft" (default), "hard" (omit all cross-parcel edges and geodesic paths), or "ignore".

metric

Distance metric for volumetric/coordinate inputs: "auto" (uses 26-connected in-mask lattice geodesic distance whenever unique integer lattice indices i, j, k are available, so out-of-mask CSF/sulcal gaps act as natural barriers, and falls back to 3D Euclidean radius/\(k\)-NN otherwise), "geodesic", or "euclidean".

n_voxels

Optional total node count \(V\) when x is an edge data.frame that may contain isolated nodes.

voxel_ids

Optional character vector of node IDs of length \(V\).

x_type

Disambiguation for matrix inputs x: "auto" (default; treats dist and Matrix inputs, as well as square \(V \times V\) numeric matrices with \(V > 3\), zero diagonal, and nonnegative entries as pairwise distance matrices, and other numeric matrices as \(V \times D\) coordinate matrices), "coords" (force interpretation as a \(V \times D\) coordinate matrix), or "distance" (force interpretation as a square \(V \times V\) distance matrix, including small \(2 \times 2\) or \(3 \times 3\) distance matrices).

Value

An S3 object of class "medusa_spatial_graph" containing 1-based CSR arrays row_ptr (length \(V + 1\)), col_idx, and dist, along with n_voxels, voxel_ids, spatial_fwhm, sigma, max_radius, max_neighbors, metric, and parcel_boundary.
